verdict.rationale: The axis applies because Trello ships an in-app AI feature to help write or edit content. However, nothing in the evidence shows that this assistant learns a user's tone, shorthand, or preferences, or personalizes its output over time. Generic AI writing help is an adjacent feature, not the personalization capability the story asks for.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can have my in-app AI assistant learn my tone, shorthand, and preferences to tailor its output

citations.quote: Use AI to help write or edit content
